summary: Fix file permissions not being explicitly set on final destination file after atomic rename

verification.ruff_command: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_storage_atomicity.py

risks: os.chmod may fail on some filesystems (e.g., FAT32) but this is acceptable as these filesystems don't support Unix permissions anyway
limitations: Windows handles file permissions differently; the fix is primarily for Unix-like systems
